name: Bedrock
summary: A mega footer under rolling hills: columns fold away, your email sprouts in the soil, a worm digs by
about: The footer of a plant nursery site, drawn as layered green hills over rich soil. Each link column folds up and unfolds with a springy stagger, all at once with Fold all, and on phones the columns become an accordion that keeps one open. Sign up for the newsletter and your email turns into a seed that arcs into the bed, kicks up dirt and grows into a sprout; Back to top launches with a puff of leaves and glides the page up.
how: Press a column title to fold or unfold it, or Fold all to fold every column.
Type your email and press Plant it; a short or broken email shakes the field.
Press Back to top to glide to the top of the page.
Every link shows where it would go; Tab and Enter work everywhere.
A demo folds the columns and plants an email by itself until you click, tap or press a key.
